title.narrative: Seeds of good living (Waküpe ko´wannötok denapök)

description.narrative: CIR and local communities in ten regions in the northern Amazonian state of Roraima strengthened in the defense of their collective rights and implementing sustainable practices and strategies for economic autonomy, territorial management and protection. Expected outcomes include politically active indigenous regions organizing themselves and liaising in search for sustainability solutions in their territories; indigenous regions strengthened and, through collaborative efforts, implementing their regional plans spearheaded by the action of regional leaders and councils, emphasizing indigenous women's plans and empowerment of young people; and indigenous organization strengthened in their organizational, administrative and political dimensions.
